_note: Hand-checked prerequisite groups (AND of OR-groups, normalized codes) that replace the machine-derived `prereqs` of a catalog row whose prereqText the upstream parser misread. lib/engine/data.ts catalogByCode() applies them; an override wins over data/catalog/*.json. Each entry was checked by hand against the row's prereqText; scripts/audit-prereqs.ts finds candidates and notes/engine-fixes.md records the reasoning and the courses deliberately left out.
